author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm) + grad-clip=1.0 — multi-τ pooling — BiGRU=160, k=7 — seed=42
abstract: Same multi-τ setup, with global-norm gradient clipping (1.0) added to the optimizer to stabilize training and potentially improve PRS/CRISPR while keeping Modif/ncRNA strong.
